name: IOCG-like terrane
expected_band: a strong magnetic signature with multi-layer support (the IOCG fingerprint)
validation_anchor: mag dominant; all four layers contribute positively

engine.model: Weights-of-Evidence mineral prospectivity mapping: per-layer W+/W-/contrast/studentized-C at the maximizing-contrast threshold, the posterior log-odds under conditional independence, the Agterberg-Cheng omnibus CI test + CI ratio, logistic regression (the CI-free generalization), and validation by success and prediction-rate capture curves and ROC AUC under spatial-block and random cross-validation, each fold fitted on its training folds only (thresholds, weights and prior). The same TS engine runs live in the browser and in the offline bake. The learned classifier + the geology OOD autoencoder (torch->ONNX) run live via onnxruntime-web; the white-box WofE posterior is the interpretable authority.

scope: Synthetic study area with known ground truth, generated from a seeded specification; it contains no real geology. Deposit labels are presence-only: a cell without a known deposit may host an undiscovered one, and the negatives used by the learned models are sampled, not observed. The held-out skill is capture@10% and the ROC AUC under spatial-block cross-validation; the random-versus-spatial gap and the conditional-independence test are reported beside them. The outputs support exploration targeting; they are not a JORC or NI 43-101 resource estimate.
